active_operation.active_tranche: DeepSeek native Harness provider-free post-HMR pre-request diagnostic-sidecar integration rehearsal

lanes.rationale: The tranche instruments the native Harness execution path itself and expressly forbids Harness, worker, model and provider activity; dispatching DeepSeek would depend on or violate the surface under test.

The initial work is a provider-free exact-source integration and hostile-fixture contract. External semantic veto adds no leverage before deterministic evidence exists and would violate the no-provider boundary.
Developer policy prohibits proactive delegation, and the future runner, accepted helper, controller identity validation and broker-zero join form one serial trust boundary.

serial_constraints: bind the immutable accepted runner and closed helper before deriving a future runner
freeze the exact future runner path and identity before controller fixture ingestion
keep sidecar validation separate from the independent broker-zero reading
admit a pre-request conclusion only from both canonical sidecar identity and broker request count zero
mechanically collect exact test counts before any status statement or acceptance

source_evidence.current_authority_allocation: GPT Sol owns rehydration, contract freeze, serial implementation, deterministic fixtures, review, acceptance and closeout. DeepSeek, Gemini and native-subagent lanes are declined because provider and Harness activity are forbidden and the runner/helper/controller identity chain is one tightly coupled serial surface.
source_evidence.git_refs_and_worktree: The machine-generated snapshot must confirm task-branch/origin alignment, all local/origin protected refs at the configured protected expected commit, tracked cleanliness, docs/branding presence and preservation of every unrelated untracked path; no Git object ID is caller supplied to the receipt builder.
source_evidence.live_handover_current_baton: Continuity 373 / Compass 355 accept the closed custom-runner failure-coordinate diagnosis and name the provider-free future-runner sidecar integration rehearsal as the active next operation.
source_evidence.protected_evidence_boundaries: The tranche may create only a new future runner derived from the immutable accepted attempt-005 runner, integrate the accepted closed helper and code-owned stage variable, and prove canonical controller ingestion plus a separate broker-zero join using provider-free fixtures. It may not mutate or reclassify consumed evidence; launch Node, Harness, broker, worker, model, provider, network, database or Docker activity; read raw attempt streams or dynamic error fields; change product or configuration; open ordinary practice, data, production, deployment, Pages or protected refs; or touch protected evidence.
